[01:38] 6341650635270069592: sure. so we're Openfield, we're in the other space. and yeah, we're in the middle of moving to Kubernetes and it forced the whole monitoring question open.
[02:19] 6341650635270069592: the team just mutes alerts at this point because ninety percent of them are noise.
[02:53] 3405216642568486089: that's a really common story. what are you using today?
[03:32] 6341650635270069592: right now it's mostly Honeydew. and the tracing is great but the dashboards are weak so we'd still need something else.
[04:28] 6341650635270069592: we've also looked at Splunkr a bit.
[05:41] 3405216642568486089: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[06:11] 6341650635270069592: we have zero visibility into what the actual user experience looks like in the browser.
[07:02] 3405216642568486089: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[07:52] 6341650635270069592: our on-call folks are getting paged constantly for stuff that doesn't matter and they're burning out.
[08:53] 3405216642568486089: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[09:51] 6341650635270069592: leadership wants us reporting on SLOs now and we don't have a clean way to measure them.
[10:32] 6341650635270069592: we're running like five different tools and none of them talk to each other.
[11:08] 3405216642568486089: makes sense. when you picture this working well, what does that look like?
[11:54] 6341650635270069592: the single-pane thing is really appealing, we're tired of jumping between tools.
[13:00] 3405216642568486089: and what would hold you back from moving on this?
[13:56] 6341650635270069592: we got burned on a migration two years ago so people are nervous about doing it again.
[15:03] 6341650635270069592: everyone's trained on the existing dashboards, there's a lot of muscle memory.
[15:54] 3405216642568486089: totally fair. let me show you how a couple of teams like yours handled exactly that.
[16:38] 6341650635270069592: yeah that'd be helpful. timeline-wise we're not in a huge rush but it's on the roadmap.
[17:08] 3405216642568486089: great — here's what I'd suggest as a next step.
[17:45] 6341650635270069592: works for me.
